map1763.line: A map of Britain's two new colonies, East and West Florida, engraved by John Gibson for the Gentleman's Magazine, London, November 1763, the year Britain took Florida. Library of Congress. Free to use.

mose.line: A map of the land between Fort Mose and St. Augustine, drawn in the 1760s by Samuel Roworth, a British mapmaker, after the people of Fort Mose had left for Cuba. Library of Congress. No known copyright restrictions.
